rules.title: San Francisco Rent Ordinance § 37.10C: ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices (software using algorithms to analyze nonpublic competitor rental data and recommend rents for vacant units) to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco. A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action for violations.
rules.key_value: Ban on sale or use of algorithmic devices; enforcement by tenant or City Attorney civil action; effective Oct. 14, 2024

coverage.summary: Applies to residential units in San Francisco; covers sale or use of algorithmic devices that analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents.

rules.quoted_span: adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024. The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.review_note: Description comes from a Rent Board news item, not the ordinance text; the ordinance's exemptions and penalty amounts are not stated in the passages.
rules.source_notes: Other documents describe the Board of Supervisors' action as approved in July 2024 (D039) or adopted in September 2024 (D076). The Rent Board notice gives the effective date as October 14, 2024.
